newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil - Russian looks thinner.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil - Russian looks thinner.

text.p: Russian high sulphur straight run looked to be thinning after a week of deals.
On Friday another M-100 found a buyer at around two means +$2.50-3.00 in NWE while in the Med a trader sold another M-100 at cif high quotes +$3 basis Falconnara.

Low sulphur straight run continued to face a standoff although a cargo was understood sold yesterday at $143 fob into Rotterdam. Buyers maintained straight run margins were poor against crude, but tight supplies did not encourage sellers to accept lower prices.
